text: {"final": {"summary": "P1: created scripts/merge_duplicates.py following scripts/ conventions (docstring stating it modifies data/registry.json, sys.path.insert before project imports). It loads all households, calls find_duplicates() to get same-family groups of active IDs, keeps the member whose household ID passes is_valid_household_id, and marks each other member status=\"merged\" with merged_into set via set_status (no deletions), printing a summary per group. P2: ran the script once; six duplicate groups were merged (Karim Odiambo, Yusuf Mensah, Ayesha Petroff, Teodor Achterberg, Muhammad Kale, Selin Ward), each keeping the record with the valid household ID. P3: replaced the misleading comment in registry/dedup.py that instructed deleting inactive households with a comment stating that merging marks records status=\"merged\" via set_status and never deletes records; no logic changes.", "done_steps": ["P1", "P2", "P3"]}}
